name: African Rainbow Minerals Limited
summary: African Rainbow Minerals Limited (ARM) functions as a diversified mining and minerals group, primarily active across South Africa and Malaysia through its various subsidiaries. Its extensive exploration and extraction activities encompass a broad range of commodities, including platinum group metals (PGMs), nickel, copper, cobalt, coal, iron ore, manganese ore, chrome ore, ferromanganese, and gold. The company was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Sandton, South Africa.
